content.comment_body: As mentioned, I work on these projects at my job and sometimes bring them home to continue. However, I encounter this error message: 'Error at loading archive [program_name]'. It's very frustrating as it slows down my workflow. The project was created with [product_name] [version_no], and I'm also using [product_name] [version_no] if anyone is wondering.
I'm seeing the error 'Error at loading archive [program_name]' for the first time. Can you explain how you archive the project?

Hello, The details provided are quite limited. [product_name] [version_no] comes in several versions, and [product_name] software now has multiple releases. I recommend upgrading to [product_name] [version_no], which supports all [product_name] devices. You need to specify which exact hardware you are using and select either [product_name] [version_no] standard or [product_name] [version_no] FS:04 according to your hardware. [product_name] [version_no] standard is for earlier devices up to FS:03, and [product_name] [version_no] FS:04 is for later models. Hope this advice helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing problems loading archived projects with [product_name] software, encountering error messages that hinder their workflow. There is uncertainty about software and hardware compatibility and a lack of informative feedback when these errors arise.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable loading of previously saved projects with consistent compatibility across software versions and devices, as well as clearer error messages and guidance.
